I thought the person wrote in my thread but it was only PM.

User who scammed me is 
https://www.reddit.com/user/SameHome

PM
https://i.imgur.com/2c8yDEV.png

Proof of transaction 
https://my.pcloud.com/publink/show?code=XZnMc67ZBdoqQYW0Pi7V7Lqx2scpoJnCPony

i didn't take proper precautions and have myself to blame. It looked all green to me at first with lots of confirmed transactions and reputation. But it seems that SameHomes started scamming ppl around February.

But I paid with paypal choosing the S/G and not "F/F" so I think papal will refund me as they said you get some kind of buyers protection when using S/G.
